phase_definition: normalized[0,1);0 midnight,.25 dawn,.5 noon,.75 dusk; map actual game sun cycle to this convention or supply alternate keyframes
interpolation: smoothstep on each neighboring pair; weights normalized; full sky coverage stays opaque
texture_pan: samephase for every sky layer; one tile width per fullgame day; modulo tile width
phase_wrap: normalize with((phase%1)+1)%1; repeating textures and wrapped marker distances; no reset animation
label_source: existing game period text; do not infer gameplay labels from the demo keyframes
